I added `'Assets'[Manufacturer]` to the DAX query in DataSet1 and exposed it as a `Manufacturer` field (bound to `Assets[Manufacturer]`, typed as String).

- **Query:** I placed the column after `'Assets'[EquipmentType]` in the `SUMMARIZECOLUMNS` group-by list. The measures are unchanged.
- **Fields:** The existing nine fields (AssetID, AssetName, Site, EquipmentType, ReportDate, OperatingHours, IdleHours, FuelLitres, Utilization) are still there with their original bindings. Manufacturer is appended as the tenth.

I didn't add Manufacturer to FleetTable or any other item. The table still shows only its original columns. I also didn't run the query, so the new column hasn't been checked against the live model.
